content.text:
The drawing is a benzene ring with four substituents. I located each ring vertex from the image positions.

- Top-left vertex: Cl
- Top-right vertex: NH2
- Right-lower vertex: NO2
- Left-lower vertex: F
- Bottom vertex: H
- Top vertex: H

Going around the ring: the top vertex (C-H) leads to the top-right vertex (C-NH2), then the lower-right vertex (C-NO2), then the bottom vertex (C-H), then the lower-left vertex (C-F), then the upper-left vertex (C-Cl), and back to the top.

Written as SMILES, starting at the amine carbon: Nc1cc(Cl)c(F)cc1[N+](=O)[O-]. Checking the ring order: C1 (NH2), then cH (top), then C-Cl, then C-F, then cH (bottom), then C-NO2, which closes back to C1. This matches the drawing.

The compound is 5-chloro-4-fluoro-2-nitroaniline.

SMILES: Nc1cc(Cl)c(F)cc1[N+](=O)[O-]
